name: code-chat-retry
about: ↻ Retry in a Code chat that works directly (16 Nov 2026; Retry and Edit there go through Rewind, #106/#140): its answer comes back in the turn's JSON. Before, the lab looked for it after the conversation's length when asked — but Rewind cuts the thread at the message and asks again, so the new answer sat where the old one was and `answer` came back empty. Now a Retry's turn starts at the person's message it answers again (turns.mjs `branchFrom`), and its question is that message. Then Edit: the message changed, the new answer read the same way. Needs the real Claude Code.

steps.ask: Reply with exactly one word: PELICAN. Don't read or change any file.

steps.note: ↻ Retry under the answer; the lab presses "Retry from this message?".
The new answer, read back (it was empty before), and the question it answered again.

steps.ask: Reply with exactly one word: FALCON. Don't read or change any file.
steps.note: Edit the message: the pencil, the words, Save and send.
